title: Journey B2, current state: a device user at a GP clinic reports an adverse event with HSA's FormSG e-form
task: A nurse at a GP clinic (not one of the hospitals in the drop-down) reports a device problem using the photo-of-label option. Modelled up to and including the Submit click; nothing was submitted in this review.
assumptions: Field list, types and required flags come from the form's public definition (S26) read on 2026-10-15.
The facility drop-down has 36 named hospitals plus 'Other'; a GP clinic must choose 'Other' and type its name.
Typed lengths are assumptions: description 300 characters.
File dialog for the photo is modelled as P + B B to open, P + B B B B to pick the file, with an unmeasured 0 s response.

navigation.action: Click 'E-form' in the Medical Devices row

fields.label: Are you submitting the device information as a photo? (Yes)
Consent to share contact details with supplier

finish.action: Review and click Submit (not performed in this review)
